content.text: NHL Inside Out Classic | Washington Capitals vs New York RangersRating: PGRelease Date: April 5, 2026Genre: Family, ChildrenInside Out meets the NHL! Live from Hockey Island inside Riley's mind is the first-ever Inside Out Classic. Get ready for an emotional showdown as Joy, Sadness, Anxiety, and the rest of Riley’s Emotions team up with the Washington Capitals and the New York Rangers in a real-time animated game set in the Mind World of Inside Out. Catch all the feels on Sunday, April 5th at 7 PM ET.ESPN commentators calling the action on the animated telecast include Drew Carter, Kevin Weekes and Arda Öcal.
